hook.en: You keep filling a bucket while it is not full. You do not know in advance how many mugs it will take. That is exactly what a while loop does.
hook.kn: ಬಕೆಟ್ ತುಂಬುವವರೆಗೆ ನೀರು ಹಾಕುತ್ತಲೇ ಇರುತ್ತೀರಿ; ಎಷ್ಟು ಮಗ್ ಬೇಕು ಎಂದು ಮೊದಲೇ ಗೊತ್ತಿಲ್ಲ. while ಲೂಪ್ ಮಾಡುವುದು ಇದನ್ನೇ.

objectives.en: Write a while loop with a correct update

narration.en: You keep filling a bucket while it is not full. You do not know in advance how many mugs it will take. That is exactly what a while loop does.
narration.kn: ಬಕೆಟ್ ತುಂಬುವವರೆಗೆ ನೀರು ಹಾಕುತ್ತಲೇ ಇರುತ್ತೀರಿ; ಎಷ್ಟು ಮಗ್ ಬೇಕು ಎಂದು ಮೊದಲೇ ಗೊತ್ತಿಲ್ಲ. while ಲೂಪ್ ಮಾಡುವುದು ಇದನ್ನೇ.

body.en: The while loop executes its body repeatedly as long as its condition is True: while condition: followed by an indented body. The condition is tested before every iteration; if it is False at the very start, the body is never executed. Some statement inside the body must change the variable in the condition, otherwise the condition stays True forever and we get an infinite loop.

points.en: while condition:  → body repeats while True
Update the loop variable, or the loop never ends

The condition is tested before every iteration; if it is False at the very start, the body is never executed. Some statement inside the body must change the variable in the condition, otherwise the condition stays True forever and we get an infinite loop.
narration.kn: while ಲೂಪ್ ಷರತ್ತು ಸತ್ಯವಾಗಿರುವವರೆಗೆ ದೇಹವನ್ನು ಮತ್ತೆ ಮತ್ತೆ ಕಾರ್ಯಗತಗೊಳಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ಪ್ರತಿ ಬಾರಿಯ ಮುನ್ನ ಷರತ್ತು ಪರೀಕ್ಷಿಸಲಾಗುತ್ತದೆ. ಚರವನ್ನು ಬದಲಿಸದಿದ್ದರೆ ಅನಂತ ಲೂಪ್ ಆಗುತ್ತದೆ.

title.en: On the board: The while loop flowchart

say.en: First the loop variable gets a starting value.
Then the condition is tested. If it is True, the body runs.
After the body, control jumps back to test the condition again. This back arrow is the loop.
When the condition becomes False, we leave the loop and go on with the program.
Output: 1, 2, 3. Forget count += 1 and the test stays True for ever: an infinite loop.

narration.en: Here is the while loop as a flowchart. Watch the arrow that goes back up.

body.en: Use a for loop when the number of iterations is known in advance or when you go over a sequence, such as a range, a string or a list. Use a while loop when you repeat until some condition changes and the number of iterations is not known beforehand, for example extracting the digits of a number, or reading values until the user types 0.

points.en: Unknown count / until a condition → while
Any for loop can be rewritten as a while loop

narration.en: Use a for loop when the number of iterations is known in advance or when you go over a sequence, such as a range, a string or a list. Use a while loop when you repeat until some condition changes and the number of iterations is not known beforehand, for example extracting the digits of a number, or reading values until the user types 0.
narration.kn: ಪುನರಾವರ್ತನೆಗಳ ಸಂಖ್ಯೆ ಮೊದಲೇ ಗೊತ್ತಿದ್ದರೆ for, ಷರತ್ತು ಬದಲಾಗುವವರೆಗೆ ಪುನರಾವರ್ತಿಸಬೇಕಾದರೆ while ಬಳಸಿ.

problem.en: Find the sum of the digits of n = 4709 using a while loop.

narration.en: n % 10 gives the last digit and n // 10 removes it. The loop stops when no digits are left, that is when n becomes 0.

homework.en: Write a program to reverse the digits of a number using a while loop (for example 4709 → 9074).

narration.en: Recap. while repeats its body as long as the condition is True. The condition is tested before each iteration. Forgetting to update the loop variable gives an infinite loop. for suits a known count; while suits "until something happens".
narration.kn: ಪುನರಾವಲೋಕನ. ಷರತ್ತು ಸತ್ಯವಾಗಿರುವವರೆಗೆ while ದೇಹವನ್ನು ಪುನರಾವರ್ತಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ಪ್ರತಿ ಪುನರಾವರ್ತನೆಯ ಮುನ್ನ ಷರತ್ತು ಪರೀಕ್ಷಿಸಲಾಗುತ್ತದೆ. ಲೂಪ್ ಚರವನ್ನು ಬದಲಿಸದಿದ್ದರೆ ಅನಂತ ಲೂಪ್ ಆಗುತ್ತದೆ. ಗೊತ್ತಿರುವ ಎಣಿಕೆಗೆ for; ಏನಾದರೂ ಆಗುವವರೆಗೆ while.
